messages:
Nora: Heads-up — customers are seeing 500s and malformed JSON in function-call responses from the hosted chat endpoint after the model rollout at 04:10 UTC. Opening thread + status: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/2816789012 :rotating_light:
Ops-Bot: Incident INC-2816789012 created. Runbook: https://internal.redwood.ai/runbooks/function-call-errors. Pager alerted to oncall.
Ethan (oncall): Acknowledged. Collecting failure samples and diffs against previous model variant. Early samples show deserialization exceptions in our function-return parser for model v2.3.1.
Infra-Bot: Rollout history: v2.3.1 deployed to hosted pool at 04:08 -> 04:12 traffic ramp. Noted an increased error ratio starting 04:11.
Nora: Mitigation plan: 1) pause rollout 2) rollback to v2.3.0 for chat pool 3) add defensive parse fallback to ignore extra top-level fields.
Ethan (oncall): Paused further rollouts. Initiated automated rollback on 6/6 affected nodes to v2.3.0. Monitoring logs for error rate.
Sam (product): Customer impact: function-call responses may be invalid JSON for some calls (affects function-calling integrations). Drafting customer blurb: "We're investigating malformed function-call responses after a recent model update; mitigations in progress." Approve?
Nora: Approve. Add note recommending retry with strict JSON validation as workaround.
Ethan (oncall): Metrics: error 500s for chat/function-call dropped from 9.4% -> 1.1% within 3m after rollback. A small tail of malformed-but-200 responses still present; parsing fallback being deployed.
Infra-Bot: CI job: https://ci.redwood.ai/runs/82999. Logs: https://logs.redwood.ai/2816789012
CS-Bot: CS notified andffected customer list generated: https://internal.redwood.ai/cs/incidents/2816789012. Sending targeted emails now.
Nora: Next steps: complete fallback parser roll, run regression tests against v2.3.1 in staging, and gate future rollouts on strict function-call schema tests. Postmortem + RCA to follow.
Ethan (oncall): Continuing to monitor. If any regression spikes over 2% error rate, we re-open pager. Thanks team. :white_check_mark:
